# Default hand offsets per controller type (SteamVR Prop_ControllerType_String).
# IMPORTANT: Currently ONLY [knuckles] (Valve Index Controllers) has been calibrated.
# All other controller profiles default to 0 and require quick in-game calibration
# (hold L3+R3 0.8s -> hold Grip -> move real hand into natural grip -> release Grip).
# Calibrated RightHand*/LeftHand* offsets from VR\config.txt are very welcome via Pull Request!
# Only used when the key is NOT set in VR\config.txt. Calibration (L3+R3) writes to config.txt.
# To return to these defaults: delete the *HandPosOffset*/*HandAngOffset* lines from config.txt.
# Pos = cm (X fwd, Y right, Z up), Ang = deg (X pitch, Y yaw, Z roll)
